title.narrative: Voluntary medical program for cardiac surgery

description.narrative: 1- Providing medical services to beneficiaries with limited income who cannot cover the costs of their treatment. 2- Performing specialized surgeries in heart surgery. 3- Providing patients with medication needs as needed. 4- Alleviating the suffering of many patients who need surgical intervention in the field of heart surgery. 5- Health education for everyone receiving treatment for prevention. 6- Assisting the Ministry of Health in the host country, which suffers from a shortage of medical staff specialized in the field of heart surgery.
30 surgical operations were performed and the number of beneficiaries was 110
Providing medical services to beneficiaries with limited income who cannot cover the costs of their treatment in the specialty of cardiac surgery
